programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Continuing his British Adventure, James travels to Cornwall, where his travelling companion is local hero, chef Paul Ainsworth. James starts with a trip to Camel Valley Vineyard and cooks chicken Veronique amongst the vines. Paul hops across the estuary to taste the award-winning oysters produced by Porthilly Farm, a five-generation family-run dairy farm who diversified into oysters, and James uses some in his individual beef pies with oysters.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The Hairy Bikers are back in Scotland, but this time, they're in the beautiful region of Dumfries and Galloway. It's another place close to Dave and Si's hearts, a rural paradise with a glorious coastline which they used to visit.

programme.title: Jamie's Money Saving Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver turns a thrifty cut of beef into a luxurious chilli con carne feast. He also shows a delicious new way for using up leftover salmon, and something a bit different to make a special meal out of the humble, thrifty spud.

programme.title: Jamie's Money Saving Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver creates a gorgeous spiced sausage bake, complete with his own mouth-watering twist on garlic bread. He makes a delicious chicken chowder for just 82p per portion too.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree plays around with fuss-free food with no cooking required; she makes a ranch muffuletta sandwich; a rotisserie chicken is the secret to her Chinese chicken salad with ginger and chilli dressing; she finishes with magical Mermaid Ice Cream.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree and her son, Todd, are delivering dinner to her dad and stepmum, so Ree makes creamy chicken cacciatore soup, Parmesan herb drop biscuits and Italian salad; for dessert, she makes her recipe of dark chocolate cheesecake.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: As James' British Adventure draws to a close, he is headed for Devon to hook up with his old mate Michael Caines, who just happens to be a Michelin-starred chef and owner of Lympstone Manor, a country house hotel and restaurant with stunning views over the River Exe. After a quick look around and a spot of foraging, James sets up his kitchen amongst Michael's young vineyard to make guinea fowl with heather and brambles.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: It's bread week in the tent and the bakers must create quick breads for the signature challenge. The technical challenge is baguettes and for the showstopper, the bakers must make edible 3D bread sculptures.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: It's week four and just nine bakers remain, and for the very first time it's batter week! Mary and Paul have set three challenges to test the bakers on some store cupboard classics. To kick-start, a British favourite, it may sound simple, but the judges are looking for perfection. A uniform bake across the batch, and topped with a tasty savoury filling, the bakers really have to rise to the occasion in this signature challenge.

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: After visiting a beekeeper, Michel is inspired to use honey as part of a delicious duck dish. Later, he tries to impress his wife with a fruit compote.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater creates a week's worth of simple but delicious meals from ingredients that are often overlooked. He effortlessly prepares a sumptuous beetroot cake, a lentil and chard stew and a beef and ale casserole, before travelling to Derbyshire to help keen gardeners Ian and Kathy create tasty food from their plot.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Mouth-watering chocolate cookies and crispy duck with honey and figs prove that a little bit of what you fancy does you good. Then to balance the scales, Nigel makes a couple of dishes full of clean-tasting flavours, with fresh herbs, tomatoes and crunchy greens - but whether saints or sinners, every dish will taste truly divine.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's digging into appetisers, dessert and everything in-between. In Laramie, WY, an old-school café is loadin' up green-chili burritos and scratch-made pie. A spot in Anchorage, AK, is going next level with their blackened chicken gnocchi.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of funky flavour, starting in Laramie, WY, where a restaurant-bar is piling up their nachos, and a longtime spot is cooking up a vegetarian banh mi. Then, a Mexican joint in Alaska is serving dynamite duck tacos.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's diving into Asian flavours alongside a taste of Italy, starting at a Vietnamese spot in Albuquerque, NM, that's servin' up out-of-bounds banh mi. Plus, in Anchorage, AK, a real deal Italian deli is adding magic to their sandwiches.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's diggin' into dishes perfect for pickin' up and chowin' down, like a bomb barbecue pie at a pizza-bakery in Laramie, WY. Then, a funky Cleveland bar is making monster tots, and a Vietnamese spot in Anchorage, AK, is cookin' up crêpes.
